title: Terminologies
lede: A dictionary of key concepts, evolutionary operators, status variables, and mechanical entities used throughout the EvoSim project.

terms.definition: A genetic operator where the synaptic MLP weights of two parent animals are combined at designated crossover points to create the neural network for a new offspring agent.
A catastrophic environmental event that affects a large zone of the grid map or the entire simulation for a specified duration, such as a Wildfire or Harsh Winter.
A temporary modifier applied to an animal that alters its base traits or status depletion rates for a limited duration, such as Poisoned, Well-Fed, or Exhausted.
A selection guarantee where a top tier percentage of the highest-performing animals from one generation are carried over directly to the subsequent generation without mutation.
The optimization methodology used to train the MLP. It replicates natural selection by generating a population, scoring survival performance via the Fitness Function, and breeding top agents.
The mathematical formula that evaluates an animal's overall survival success at the conclusion of a round. This score determines parental probability in the selection pool.
A complete lifecycle iteration of the simulation arena. A cohort of animals lives, competes, and dies, and the fittest individuals seed the next generation.
The primary turn-by-turn phase where each animal's neural network consumes sensory inputs and emits an intentional action: translating across tiles, foraging, or resting.
A feedforward artificial neural network acting as the decision-making brain for each animal, processing status vectors and sensory grid arrays into discrete actions.
A genetic operator that applies small stochastic disturbances to an offspring's synaptic weights, introducing novel behavioral variations and preventing local minima stagnation.
The computer science domain of using evolutionary search algorithms to optimize artificial neural network parameters instead of gradient descent.
An innate, category-specific biological trait that remains perpetually active for an animal, such as a Carnivore's Ambush Predator bonus or a Herbivore's Grazing efficiency.
A simulation-wide condition that alters environmental availability and status modifiers for a one-week cycle, such as a Drought or Resource Bloom.
The probabilistic mechanism within the EA that chooses breeding pairs from the population based on fitness score rankings.
A dynamic, real-time physiological variable reflecting an animal's immediate condition: Health, Hunger, Thirst, Energy, and Instinct.
A core, semi-permanent genetic attribute of an animal (Strength, Agility, Endurance, Intelligence) that influences physical performance and success check rolls.
A localized contextual encounter initiated when specific spatial or state thresholds are breached, presenting a challenge such as an Animal Conflict or Sudden Hazard.
